decision: Freeze a Codex static snapshot only after exact product terms permit internal analysis; admit or publish derived connectivity only after public-display terms pass.

claim_contract.units: synapses; aggregation and direction remain snapshot-specific

data_clock.snapshot_policy: Pin dataset and static snapshot; a changed portal/catalog fetch is a new world version, not silent replacement.
data_clock.as_of_rule: No acquisition when internal-use terms are unresolved; no public-derived display when display terms are unresolved.

sources.custody: No raw graph or protected token in git; exact selected-product terms and download metadata must be archived before local acquisition.

material_assumptions: Dataset and snapshot are explicit and never inferred from a live query.
Cell-type joins and directed edge aggregation are source-specific.
Unknown internal-use terms stop at RESEARCHED; unknown public-display terms with a lawfully frozen local snapshot yield WITHHELD_LICENSE.

decisive_controls.positive: directed cell-type edge meeting threshold in pinned snapshot
decisive_controls.negative: reversed edge, wrong cell type, or below threshold
decisive_controls.null: unresolved terms, absent snapshot, or duplicate-unresolved edge
decisive_controls.isolation: NeuroVault/Arc records cannot satisfy this claim

public_policy: Until exact display terms pass, no evidence-derived content is public; a lawful local freeze may still be recorded as WITHHELD_LICENSE.
